newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Reserve Bank confirms minor rand support.
newsitem.headline: S.African Reserve Bank confirms minor rand support.

text.p: The South African Reserve Bank was active in the rand foreign exchange market on Wednesday but a spokesman said its intervention had been small-scale.
Some dealers had described the action as "quite aggressive" but the spokesman said this was not the case.

"The Reserve Bank has not been aggressive. We were in the market but it was very, very small. I think what we are seeing is exporter-driven proceeds coming through," he said of the sharp rise in the currency.
The rand was last trading at 4.6800/6850 against the U.S. dollar from the morning's weakest level of 4.7290/7340 and 4.7180/7230 at 1400 GMT Tuesday.
